_README: The report may only use reference values that appear in this file AND carry a source.
If a variable has no usable entry, the report prints 'Individualized assessment required'.
Nothing is inferred and nothing is remembered from the language model.
SHIPPED EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Populating this is a sports-science task, not a coding task.
An entry with source null, status NEEDS_SOURCE, or no measure/phase mapping is rejected
by S5 and listed in the report. Example: a pelvic-rotation reference range that appears
in an earlier hand-made report must be traced to a citation before it goes in here.
evidence_class must be one of: literature, coaching_convention, athlete_baseline.
measure must be a measure name the pipeline produces, for example 'pelvic_yaw_range_deg'.
scope is 'stride' (per-stride metric) and leg is 'both' unless the entry is leg-specific.
